prompt:
You are given {n_clauses} clauses from a US consumer-finance company's internal compliance policy manual. Each clause has a clause id (like K0001) and was written to implement exactly one paragraph of the federal regulations in an offline library of {n_parts} parts of the Code of Federal Regulations, covering consumer credit, electronic fund transfers, privacy notices, credit reporting, mortgage servicing, deposit accounts, children's online privacy, information security, identity theft and anti-money-laundering rules.

The clauses never name the regulation or its numbers. They are written as everyday staff procedures in plain business words rather than the regulation's own terms, so keyword search alone is unreliable: you must match each clause's actors, triggers, deadlines and amounts against the regulation text.

For each clause, cite the regulation paragraph it implements. A correct citation gives the section number and the first-level paragraph letter, written like "12 CFR 1024.35(e)". A more specific citation inside that paragraph, like "12 CFR 1024.35(e)(1)", is also accepted. A citation without a paragraph letter, or to the wrong paragraph of the right section, is wrong.

Watch out for parallel provisions: several regulations contain similar wording for, e.g., different notices, different kinds of disputes or requests, or different account types. These provisions differ in details such as deadlines, dollar amounts, who must act and under what conditions, so verify those details before choosing between look-alike paragraphs.

The offline library is the only source; there is no internet access. Use list_clauses to page through the clauses, list_sections to see the table of contents, read_section to read a section's paragraphs with their designations, and search for keyword search over all paragraphs.

Final answer: one JSON object mapping every clause id to its citation, for example:
{"K0001": "12 CFR 1024.35(e)", "K0002": "16 CFR 314.4(c)"}
Every clause id must appear in the object; clauses that are missing count as wrong.
tool_list_clauses: Lists the policy-manual clauses with their clause ids and text. Page through them with offset and limit.
tool_list_sections: Shows the library's table of contents: every section's citation and heading. Optionally restrict the listing to one part.
tool_read_section: Reads a section's paragraphs with their designations, starting from a given start paragraph.
tool_search: Keyword search over all paragraphs in the library. Returns paragraph citations with the start of their text.
unit_prompt: You are given one clause, {clause_id}, from a US consumer-finance company's internal compliance policy manual.
